reasons.correctness: Implements the repository finder, closeStaleResolvedTickets with a now-minus-days cutoff, and StaleTicketCloseCronJob with the disabled guard and catch-and-log. Property names and defaults match the interface. Build green, 4/4 hidden and 53/53 existing tests pass.
reasons.convention_fit: The @Scheduled method carries @SchedulerLock named support:ticketStaleClose. Cron and enabled flag come from @Value properties, and the class is named *CronJob. Injection uses a private final field with @RequiredArgsConstructor. No field @Autowired, and the change stays in the support/ticket feature package.
reasons.design_fit: The service owns the closing logic, the repository holds a derived query, and the cron job only delegates. It reuses the existing ShedLock and property-driven job pattern. No duplicated lookup, and the footprint is small, with defaults mirrored in application.yml.
reasons.test_quality: Two MockitoExtension unit test classes with no Spring context. They cover closing and the returned count, the cutoff window via ArgumentCaptor, the empty case with never-save, the disabled skip with verifyNoInteractions, and exception swallowing.
reasons.graph_use: Before editing, graph queries located the support/ticket files, the existing *CronJob exemplars and the TESTED_BY tests. The agent then read InvoiceRetryCronJob and AnonymousConsentCleanupCronJob and followed their structure.
